free_tier.stated: A free seedbox trial account for 1 to 3 days is offered, but the request form answers 'Out of stock' today; the entry paid plan is 1 TB at EUR 10.95 per month.
free_tier.notes: The true unit is days (a 1 to 3 day trial); the vocabulary has no days term. The trial request form asks for an email address, a username and a password, and refuses VPN, proxy and Tor requests.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: sold by total disk (930 GB on the 1 TB plan); no single-file cap is published

retention.stated: for the life of the subscription; no inactivity deletion is stated

egress.terms: 'Unmetered' up/down traffic on a 1Gbps interface; the FAQ says 'No, we do not limit upload and download traffic.'

interface_detail: Torrent, FTP and HTTP file manager on every plan; ruTorrent web client.
tooling: FTP client, HTTP file manager and ruTorrent; no API or CLI is documented
chaining: A EUR 10.95 1 TB unmetered seedbox with an FTP pull path; public trackers are not allowed

limits.value: 1 Gbps interface, unmetered traffic; public trackers not allowed

limits_note: Plans run 1 TB EUR 10.95 to 8 TB EUR 44.95 a month with 930 GB to 7,440 GB of disk. Public trackers are not allowed.
binding_note: No quota or object cap is published; the trial is out of stock and the paid disk is the planning number.

identity_cost.detail: The trial form asks for an email address, a username and a password. Payment is by PayPal or Bitcoin. Phone and document requirements are not stated on the pages read.

reliability_note: The free trial request form shows 'Out of stock', so the trial is not obtainable today; the unmetered claim carries no fair-use numbers.
confidence_note: Plans, prices, trial and payment are on the vendor pages read on 2026-11-03. A measured rung needs a slot and a timed transfer.
